question: Are there ever secrets about characters that Nagatsuki-sensei tells the Re voice actors, even though he hasn't revealed them in the original work or at Q&A events?
answer:
Sometimes, yes.

I believe I told Seki-san, who plays Al, about Al's true identity.

Regarding Reinhard, there were also times when I thought, “It might be bad if I don't tell Nakamura-san about this,” so I told him some things as well.

Since it's a fairly recent topic, I think the Al-related information is probably the biggest secret I've told anyone recently.
